preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the string n for each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min_erased) if min_erased != -1 else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of erased symbols or -1 if it's impossible to make the string a palindrome.
